from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]; seen=set()

            if grid[r][c]!=0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
